# NITA Gallery

> NITA Gallery is an art gallery at 68 Campbell Street, Surry Hills, Sydney NSW 2010, Australia. It shows abstract paintings by Ritushka,
> fine-art photography by Nick Brand Photography, wearable art (scarves and sarongs) by the Nikki B label, and a cabinet of jewellery.
> Ritushka runs a painting studio at the gallery, and Nick Brand runs a photo studio there. Each artist also has a second studio in
> Lane Cove, Sydney (Nick Brand Photography: 84 Centennial Avenue, Lane Cove NSW 2066).

## Visit
- Address: 68 Campbell Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010
- Opening hours: Tuesday and Wednesday 10am-6pm; Thursday 10am-8pm; Friday 10am-6pm; Saturday 10am-3pm; closed Sunday and Monday; also open by appointment any day, including outside these hours
- Parking is difficult nearby; a train is suggested, and there is a car park across the road.
- Email: studio@nitagallery.com.au
- Phone: Ritushka 0405 441 516; Nick 0403 835 467
- Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=68+Campbell+Street+Surry+Hills+NSW+2010

## Prices (Australian dollars)
- Ritushka original paintings (available works): A$1,450 to A$5,250, framed
- Nick Brand Photography Fifty Pages of Shades limited editions (edition of 50, framed): price depends on the size of print, please inquire
- Nikki B scarves and sarongs (100% Modal, 100 x 200 cm): AUD $120
- Ritushka limited edition prints (signed and numbered, unframed, archival giclee on cotton rag): AUD $100 to AUD $850, by size
- Second Skin jewellery: price shown on each piece in the shop
- Online shop: Second Skin jewellery and Nikki B scarves and sarongs, delivered worldwide (delivery priced by country), paid securely in AUD through Stripe
